scope: Independently authored small multilingual tables with horizontal and vertical merges. These are static observations, not live Word execution, general PDF fidelity or full #151 qualification.
referenceTools: LibreOffice 24.2.7.2 in image sha256:a3aaef646226d406fc2b511462beb0359f4cd8859d775f404bd8f137dfd5f644 with the repository fonts mounted read-only; Poppler 24.02.0 pdftotext -layout and -bbox-layout; Open XML SDK 3.5.1 validator DLL sha256:4126071233c70310683c0fa0b65648bbd34839afa7b0a2309fba13c22501ddec.

hindi.observation: The generator reproduced the input byte for byte and Open XML validation found zero errors. Both text extractions contain the same Hindi clusters, Latin labels and decimal values; the independent checker confirmed their row and column ownership. Reference and native top coordinates for Total were 116.992 and 147.691 points: native rows were taller by 30.699 points at that location. The BestEffort probe observed Typography.MergedTableSpacing; strict output rejects this known difference.

arabicExploration.observation: A preliminary working-tree build admitted the mixed Arabic/Hindi specimen. Poppler -layout extracted Arabic logical text differently and its first Arabic word box began at x=72.000 points, compared with x=100.050 in LibreOffice. Right-to-left and mixed-direction merged tables are now rejected; this difference is not counted as a pass.

earlierAttempts: The first independent fixture placed bidi after spacing in paragraph properties; Open XML validation reported one error. The corrected input had zero errors. An initial standalone probe omitted the native provider and failed before rendering; a later parallel scratch restore had an MSBuild worker failure. A scratch probe then built with a Skia version warning; explicitly matching the repository's 4.153.1 bindings removed the warning and supplied the provider. An earlier focused test expected a new diagnostic for PDF/A but the existing Typography.Conformance rejection occurs first; the corrected expectation passed.
